Title: Homes With No Maintenance Defects
Label: Homes With No Maintenance Problems
Subtitle: Percentage of renter-occupied homes that reported any maintenance deficiencies (water leaks, cracks and holes, inadequate heating, presence of mice or rats, toilet breakdowns, or peeling paint).
MethodsNote: No maintenance deficiencies includes heating equipment breakdown, additional heating required, rodent infestation, cracks/holes in the walls, ceilings or floors, broken plaster/peeling paint larger than 8½ x 11 inches, toilet breakdowns, or water leaks from outside the unit.
indicatorDetail: Including water leaks, cracks and holes, inadequate heating, presence of mice or rats, toilet breakdowns, or peeling paint.
